svg.text: lean-dag: the support structure of the development
An arrow A → B means A is used in the proof of B — directly, or through unlabelled lemmas. Assumptions on the left; each column is one step further from them.
Extracted from the Lean environment; arrows implied by longer paths are removed. A box with no incoming arrow rests only on definitions and unlabelled lemmas.
